#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

enum State { OUTSIDE, INSIDE };

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string str;
    cin >> str;
    
    vector<int> temp(n, 0);
    int count = 0;
    int k = 0;
    State state = str[0] == '(' ? INSIDE : OUTSIDE;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = str[i];
        switch (state) {
            case OUTSIDE:
                if (c == '_') {
                    k++;
                } else if (c == '(') {
                    state = INSIDE;
                } else {
                    temp[k]++;
                }
                break;

            case INSIDE:
                if (c == ')') {
                    state = OUTSIDE;
                    k++;
                } else if (i > 0) {
                    char prev = str[i - 1];
                    if ((prev == '(' || prev == '_') && c != '_' && c != '(') {
                        count++;
                    }
                }
                break;
        }
    }

    int swap;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = i; j > 0; j--) {
            if (temp[j] > temp[j - 1]) {
                swap = temp[j];
                temp[j] = temp[j - 1];
                temp[j - 1] = swap;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << temp[0] << endl;
    cout << count << endl;

    return 0;
}
